name: helper-never-attacks
description: Ported from the playthrough bot's --helper=on mode and HelperChecks. The player's helper runs the economy and army against a raider for 10 minutes while the player does nothing. It must build up, and must never start a war or give an attack order.

checks.name: the player's side never starts a war
the helper never gives an attack order
the helper put constructors to work
